κεραμεύς, -εως, ὁ
(κεράννυμι), [in LXX for יָצַר, Psa.2:9, Jer.18:2, al. ;]

elsewhere.note: They took counsel, and bought the potter’s field with them, to bury strangers in.
Or hasn’t the potter a right over the clay, from the same lump to make one part a vessel for honor, and another for dishonor?
